name: bleedingdeacons/wp-mocks
description: Shared WordPress test doubles for The Bleeding Deacons plugin suite: a state-backed stub layer over Brain Monkey, plus fakes for $wpdb and the WP HTTP API.

comment-require: PHPUnit is DELIBERATELY absent from require, and must stay absent.
10up/wp_mock declares phpunit/phpunit ^9.6 in its own require, which is
what silently pinned this whole plugin suite to PHPUnit 9.6.35 even where
composer.json asked for ^9.6|^10.0. Brain Monkey avoids that trap by
declaring no phpunit constraint at all, and so does this package: the
consuming plugin supplies its own PHPUnit. src/TestCase.php extends
PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase, but it is only ever autoloaded from inside a
test run, where PHPUnit is by definition present.
See tests/PackageConstraintsTest.php, which fails if phpunit reappears here.
